summary: A dental clinic open since 1992 with four dentists appears to lose patients to a free builder address, a 2020 footer and a WhatsApp number that is not tappable, with Black Friday on 27 November.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address with the Wix advert at the top, and the footer appears to say 2020.
findings.cost: A clinic with four dentists and decades of history looks small and neglected next to clinics with their own domain and a current date.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a current footer.

findings.problem: The contact is a hotmail address and the WhatsApp number appears only as plain text, not as a tap to chat button.
findings.cost: A patient who wants to ask a quick question has to copy the number first, and many will message another clinic instead.
findings.fix: A professional email and a one tap WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: Nine services each have a Book Now button, but I found no offer, package or promotion page for Black Friday and no way to capture an email.
findings.cost: Patients look for whitening and check up deals on Black Friday, and a clinic with nothing to promote has no list to send an offer to.
findings.fix: A Black Friday offer page with a countdown and email capture.
